evidence_type: CEO memo reported by Reuters; company AI strategy release
source_tier: Secondary reporting of a primary internal memo
ai_deployment_evidence: Proprietary models for demand forecasting, operational optimisation, personalisation and generative AI; AI Shopping Assistant launched July 2026; conversational search; RFID plus computer vision and robotics for inventory; frontline associate agents in development
quantified_metrics: RFID bakery pilot in ~1,500 stores: 98% read rate, ~70% faster inventory counts, 50% drop in waste; rollout to 2,300+ stores by 2029; AI literacy training to 400,000+ associates
workforce_action: ~3,000 corporate roles to be eliminated over three years (~37% of 8,200 corporate staff), not backfilled. Follows ~1,000 corporate cuts in June 2025.
ai_attributed_by_company: PARTIAL. The memo cites 'more layers, more handoffs and more overhead than we need' and does not state how many roles AI replaces. The September 2026 AI strategy release said the aim is not to automate everything and that human connection 'will never be replaced by AI'.
analyst_caveat: Media framing is 'AI job cuts'; the primary memo frames it as delayering. Analysts noted some cuts would have occurred regardless of AI. The share of the 3,000 located in Cincinnati is not disclosed.

ai_deployment_evidence: All engineering teams use AI tools and have applied them to decode nearly all legacy applications; all colleagues have access to AI tools; generative AI training launched 2025; agentic workflows and customer-facing solutions planned
quantified_metrics: Q4 2025: ~30% of new code AI-generated; >80% of IT unit tests AI-executed; change-failure rate down >20% year over year; 56% of colleagues using AI tools daily
workforce_action: None announced in connection with AI
ai_attributed_by_company: NO workforce reduction attributed to AI. CEO Tim Spence states that his commercial clients indicate AI is NOT what is driving recent productivity gains, attributing those instead to post-COVID investment in legacy automation technologies.
analyst_caveat: Secondary sources reported '60%' daily usage; the primary filing says 56%. Use 56%.

source_tier: Secondary reporting of a company announcement

analyst_caveat: Frequently cited in AI-displacement commentary despite no company AI attribution. Cincinnati-specific share not disclosed.
